tools.name: golden_calculator
tools.description: The goldenratio.app Golden Calculator. Stack spacers numbered 1-11 (each is the previous x 1.618) on a left and a right side; returns whether both sides are equal and, if not, every combination of spacers that would make the shorter side match ("Try" on the site). The site starts with left = [6, 5,

tools.name: golden_spacing
tools.description: The golden spacing scale (spacers 1-11 plus half-N and double-N) with exact values, px and CSS variable names, as used by goldenratio.app and the tailwindcss-golden-ratio plugin. With default options it also returns the rounded cheatsheet table from goldenratio.app/#/spacing.

tools.name: golden_grid
tools.description: The golden grid from goldenratio.app/#/grid: w-grp-1..11, w-grp-half-*, w-grp-double-* percentage widths, the starter .container/.row CSS, every example row from the site with its total width, and an optional check of your own row (does it add up to exactly 100%?).

tools.name: golden_css_variables
tools.description: The :root block of golden-ratio CSS variables (--golden-ratio-1..11, half-*, double-*, --gr) exactly as goldenratio.app ships it. Use without Tailwind.

tools.name: tailwind_plugin_setup
tools.description: How to add the tailwindcss-golden-ratio plugin (the one goldenratio.app uses): install command, tailwind.config.js, options, and the exact theme values it generates (spacing, grp widths, scale, fontSize extras, borderWidth/lineHeight) for the given options.

tools.name: golden_ratio_steps
tools.description: Step any number up or down the golden ratio (x or / 1.61803398875), e.g. to pick a type scale or the next size. What the goldenratio.app Alfred workflow does.
